import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Trim whitespace in textual columns that have variants
    for col in ["island", "species"]:
        if df[col].dtype == object:
            df[col] = df[col].str.strip()
    # Standardise species case (e.g., "chinstrap" -> "Chinstrap")
    df["species"] = df["species"].str.title()
    # Ensure numeric columns are proper numbers (they may be read as strings)
    for col in ["flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g"]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")
    return df

def answer(df):
    clean_df = clean(df)
    # Count penguins per island
    result = clean_df["island"].value_counts().to_dict()
    return result
